_: Copy to webapp/runner.json and fill in host.  Nothing here is hardcoded in the code: the GPU box is elastically addressed, so it is configuration.  Env vars OPTIMAP_HOST / OPTIMAP_KEY / OPTIMAP_REPO / OPTIMAP_PYTHON override the file.
_host: user@host or a Host alias -- e.g. ubuntu@203.0.113.10 or ubuntu@100.48.53.44 (tailscale). Empty = browsing/export only, launching disabled.  Use "local" to run the SAME kernels here through numba's CUDA simulator (NUMBA_ENABLE_CUDASIM=1, ~1000x slower: tiny S/iters, small complex) -- that is how the launch/live/stop loop can be exercised without the GPU box.
_remote_python: the numba+CUDA interpreter on the GPU host; a repo-root .venv/bin/python also works (see experiments/s6_chain_first_campaign.md)
_local_python: interpreter for simulations: needs numba (+ matplotlib only for the export button)
